steps.title: Synthesize King's practice and establish the experiential-learning typology
steps.summary: Use the Experiential Learning Strategic Community of Practice as the principal route to surface, compare and codify strong practice already present across King's. Establish a practical typology spanning curriculum and co-curriculum, identify the educational purposes different forms of experience serve, and make visible where current practice already challenges a narrow placement-led account of experiential learning.

outputs.title: King's experiential-learning practice synthesis
outputs.summary: A concise synthesis of existing institutional practice, expertise and emerging principles, showing the breadth of experiential learning already present across disciplines and contexts.

outputs.title: Working experiential-learning typology
outputs.summary: A usable typology that distinguishes materially different forms of experiential learning and provides a common language for later design, assurance and growth decisions.

existingCapacity.role: Experiential Learning Strategic Community of Practice
existingCapacity.contribution: Provide the institutional forum, practitioner expertise and challenge through which existing practice is surfaced, compared and codified.

existingCapacity.role: Experiential Learning Curriculum and Policy Development Capacity
existingCapacity.contribution: Provide specialist synthesis, curriculum and academic-development capacity across the North Star, curriculum-growth and near-curriculum workstreams without creating separate fractional roles in each deliverable.
Support coordination, evidence collation, workshops, documentation and action tracking.

enablingConditions.condition: The Strategic Community of Practice is active early enough in 2026/27 to contribute substantive practitioner input.
enablingConditions.whatItUnlocks: A North Star grounded in King's real practice rather than designed as a centrally imposed abstraction.
enablingConditions.riskIfMissing: The framework could become generic, less credible to practitioners and weaker as a basis for later adoption.

steps.title: Co-design and test the King's North Star and future student entitlement
steps.summary: Translate the practice synthesis and theoretical basis into a distinctive institutional proposition. Define the learning-design, reflection, assessment, inclusion, support and assurance principles that should characterise experiential learning at King's, and develop a credible future student-entitlement ambition. Test the proposition with students, educators, professional services and the live policy and module work in 2.2.3 so that the North Star is ambitious but operationally meaningful.

outputs.title: Draft King's experiential-learning North Star
outputs.summary: A coherent draft framework setting out the educational rationale, typology, design principles, assessment and reflection expectations, inclusion requirements and reusable delivery concepts.

outputs.title: Draft future student-entitlement ambition
outputs.summary: A clear statement of the experiential learning students should ultimately be able to expect through a King's education, framed as a future implementation ambition rather than a claim of current universal provision.

outputs.title: Stakeholder and student testing record
outputs.summary: Evidence of how the draft proposition has been tested, challenged and refined with students and the academic and professional communities that will need to use it.

existingCapacity.owner: Relevant faculties and King's professional services
existingCapacity.contribution: Test the proposition against disciplinary diversity, student need, curriculum constraints and practical delivery requirements.

yearlyProfile.note: Targeted student partnership, testing, workshop and evaluation activity supporting the North Star and entitlement design.

newInvestment.rationale: Creates enough genuinely incremental capacity to test the proposition with students and users rather than relying only on internal expert development.
newInvestment.riskIfMissing: The North Star may be intellectually coherent but insufficiently tested against student experience, accessibility and practical use.

steps.title: Ratify the North Star and set the forward implementation trajectory
steps.summary: Finalize the institutional North Star and future entitlement ambition, incorporating learning from the curriculum baseline in 2.1.4 and the sandwich-year and Level 6 capstone work in 2.2.3. Establish the forward implementation trajectory, including the requirements that later curriculum growth, near-curriculum provision, partnership infrastructure and assurance activity should meet.

outputs.title: Ratified experiential-learning North Star
outputs.summary: The agreed King's framework and aspiration for experiential learning, suitable for use as a design and investment reference point across the programme.

outputs.title: Future student-entitlement statement
outputs.summary: The agreed direction of travel for the experiential learning students should ultimately expect, with implementation staged rather than overclaimed in Year 1.

outputs.title: 2027/28 onward implementation roadmap
outputs.summary: A sequenced plan linking the North Star to curriculum growth, near-curriculum routes, assurance, enabling infrastructure and the next institutional decisions.

existingCapacity.owner: Relevant education governance and executive sponsors
existingCapacity.contribution: Provide the route to sense-check, endorse and embed the North Star as an institutional reference point.

enablingConditions.condition: Sufficiently mature evidence from 2.1.4 and live design learning from 2.2.3.
enablingConditions.whatItUnlocks: A Year 1 North Star and roadmap grounded in both institutional aspiration and practical implementation evidence.
enablingConditions.riskIfMissing: The roadmap may need earlier recalibration in 2027/28 as curriculum and regulatory evidence catches up.

steps.title: Steward and refine the framework through the first implementation cycle
steps.summary: Use the first targeted curriculum-growth and near-curriculum implementation activity to test whether the North Star works as a practical design and assurance framework. Capture where the typology, entitlement, assessment expectations or reusable models need refinement and maintain a living connection between scholarship and implementation.

outputs.title: First implementation learning review
outputs.summary: A structured review of how the North Star performs in live curriculum and near-curriculum implementation, with agreed refinements where evidence supports them.

steps.title: Refresh the entitlement and institutional framework from scaled evidence
steps.summary: Refresh the North Star and entitlement ambition using evidence from scaled curriculum growth, near-curriculum provision and wider experiential-learning delivery. Confirm what should become stable institutional policy, guidance and business-as-usual stewardship after mobilisation.

outputs.title: Mobilisation-end experiential-learning framework and stewardship recommendation
outputs.summary: An updated framework, entitlement trajectory and recommendation for enduring ownership, refresh and assurance after the three-year mobilisation.
